record.context_brief: Existence of Ulrich bundles on smooth varieties
record.original_question: Which smooth projective varieties admit Ulrich bundles? Equivalently, for which smooth projective varieties can one find a vector bundle satisfying the standard Ulrich vanishing and linear-resolution conditions?

evidence.quote: Our question in this topic is: Question 5. Which smooth projective varieties carry Ulrich bundles?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^N$ be a smooth projective variety of dimension $n$ over an algebraically closed field, embedded by a very ample line bundle $\mathcal{O}_X(1)$. A coherent sheaf $\mathcal{E}$ on $X$ is called an Ulrich bundle (with respect to $\mathcal{O}_X(1)$) if $\mathcal{E}$ is a locally free sheaf such that 
$$H^i(X, \mathcal{E}(-j)) = 0 \quad \text{for all } i \geq 0 \text{ and } 1 \leq j \leq n.$$
Equivalently, the pushforward of $\mathcal{E}$ under a finite linear projection $X \to \mathbb{P}^n$ is a trivial bundle, and equivalently $\mathcal{E}$ admits a linear resolution over $\mathbb{P}^N$ of the form 
$$0 \to \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^N}(-N+n)^{\oplus a_{N-n}} \to \cdots \to \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^N}(-1)^{\oplus a_1} \to \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^N}^{\oplus a_0} \to \mathcal{E} \to 0.$$

Determine for which smooth projective varieties $X$ (with respect to some, or every, very ample polarization $\mathcal{O}_X(1)$) there exists an Ulrich bundle $\mathcal{E}$ on $X$. In particular, does every smooth projective variety admit, for some very ample embedding, an Ulrich bundle?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of which smooth projective varieties carry Ulrich bundles is widely regarded as open, often referred to as the Eisenbud–Schreyer conjecture (which expects a positive answer). Numerous partial results exist for special classes — varieties of minimal degree, certain surfaces and threefolds via the Serre construction, blow-ups, and varieties with low Picard rank — but the general existence problem remains unresolved as of recent (2024–2025) preprints.

status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing the existence question of Ulrich bundles, posed by Eisenbud–Schreyer, still open in general.
status_evidence.claim: The general existence problem for Ulrich bundles is open.

status_evidence.title: On existence of Ulrich sheaf (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent preprint addressing partial cases of the existence of Ulrich sheaves.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on the existence problem, which remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Some evidence for the existence of Ulrich bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Provides evidence supporting the conjectural existence of Ulrich bundles.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains open and is supported by partial evidence.
